command.summary: Create a subnet and associate an existing NSG and route table.

parameters.name: --name
parameters.help: The subnet name.

parameters.name: --resource-group
parameters.help: Name of resource group. You can configure the default group using `az configure --defaults group=<name>`.

parameters.name: --vnet-name
parameters.help: The virtual network (VNet) name.

parameters.name: --address-prefixes
parameters.help: Space-separated list of address prefixes in CIDR format. If provided, --ipam-allocations should not be specified. Support shorthand-syntax, json- file and yaml-file. Try "??" to show more.

parameters.name: --default-outbound
parameters.help: Set this property to false to disable default outbound connectivity for all VMs in the subnet.

parameters.name: --delegations
parameters.help: Space-separated list of services to whom the subnet should be delegated, e.g., Microsoft.Sql/servers. Support shorthand-syntax, json-file and yaml-file. Try "??" to show more.

parameters.name: --disable-private-endpoint-network-policies
parameters.help: Disable private endpoint network policies on the subnet. Please note that it will be replaced by `--private- endpoint-network-policies` soon.

parameters.name: --disable-private-link-service-network-policies
parameters.help: Disable private link service network policies on the subnet. Please note that it will be replaced by `--private-link- service-network-policies` soon.

parameters.name: --endpoints
parameters.help: An array of service endpoints. Support shorthand-syntax, json- file and yaml-file. Try "??" to show more.

parameters.name: --ipam-allocations
parameters.help: A list of IPAM Pools for allocating IP address prefixes. If provided, --address-prefixes would be ignored by CLI and should not be specified. Support shorthand-syntax, json- file and yaml-file. Try "??" to show more.

parameters.name: --nat-gateway
parameters.help: Name or ID of a NAT gateway to attach.

parameters.name: --network-security-group
parameters.help: Name or ID of a network security group (NSG).

parameters.name: --no-wait
parameters.help: Do not wait for the long- running operation to finish.

parameters.name: --ple-network-policies
parameters.help: Manage network policies for private endpoint.

parameters.name: --pls-network-policies
parameters.help: Manage network policy for private link service.

parameters.name: --route-table
parameters.help: Name or ID of a route table to associate with the subnet.

parameters.name: --service-endpoint-policy
parameters.help: Space-separated list of names or IDs of service endpoint policies to apply. Support shorthand-syntax, json-file and yaml-file. Try "??" to show more.

parameters.name: --service-endpoints
parameters.help: Space-separated list of services allowed private access to this subnet. Support shorthand- syntax, json-file and yaml- file. Try "??" to show more.

parameters.name: --sharing-scope
parameters.help: Set this property to Tenant to allow sharing subnet with other subscriptions in your AAD tenant. This property can only be set if defaultOutboundAccess is set to false, both properties can only be set if subnet is empty.

parameters.name: --acquire-policy-token
parameters.help: Acquiring an Azure Policy token automatically for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --change-reference
parameters.help: The related change reference ID for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --debug
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.

parameters.name: --help
parameters.help: Show this help message and exit.

parameters.name: --only-show-errors
parameters.help: Only show errors, suppressing warnings.

parameters.name: --output
parameters.help: Output format.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.help: JMESPath query string. See http://jmespath.org/ for more information and examples.

parameters.name: --subscription
parameters.help: Name or ID of subscription. You can configure the default subscription using `az account set -s NAME_OR_ID`.

parameters.name: --verbose
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity. Use --debug for full debug logs.
